validation_summary.full_pytest_and_release_candidate_build: NOT_EXECUTED: no release-validation scope or deployment authorization

integration_handoff.mode: Completed WeChat reply and owned history directly mount the existing safe preview in the conversation; no HTML download needed
integration_handoff.shared_component: WorkbenchWechatArticle.mountManual with inlineBody=true; existing buildManualExport and previewDocument reused unchanged
integration_handoff.security: Empty sandbox, restrictive CSP and no-referrer; untrusted article has no host-origin access. Existing sanitizer, internal-path redaction, owner/session checks and Agent gates preserved.
integration_handoff.clipboard: Existing text/html and text/plain ClipboardItem path retained. Failures are not reported as rich-copy success.
integration_handoff.metadata: Existing separate title/digest/cover display preserved. Missing digest is explicitly unavailable, not invented or synced to WeChat.
integration_handoff.streaming: Inline article mounts only at validated completion or authorized history restoration. No Runtime/SSE/Provider/Stop changes.
integration_handoff.other_agents: Stable WeChat slug only; generic Agent reply UI unchanged
integration_handoff.dependencies: Agent Publish/Enable and model authorization still required for new article generation; no Schema016 or draft/add dependency
integration_handoff.source_integration: Review the exact successor commit on this feature branch; no automatic source switch, install or deployment

scope_preservation: Original dirty root worktree untouched; no Secret, API, Runtime, Prompt, Skill, Schema, Migration, Guard/Approval, PRIMARY, Test or Production changes
